name: UnCSO2
tagline: Extract Counter-Strike: Online 2 and Titanfall Online game files
blurb: A file data extractor for the video games Counter Strike: Online 2 and Titanfall Online.
description:
A file data extractor for the video games Counter Strike: Online 2 and Titanfall Online.

Aside from extracting files from Counter-Strike: Online 2's and Titanfall Online's proprietary archive format, PKG, UnCSO2 can:

• Explore and extract from individual PKG archives

• Explore and extract from entire game's filesystem (loads every PKG archive in their PKG index)

• Preview and/or extract individual file entries

• Decrypt Counter-Strike: Online 2 files with an .e* prepended in their extension

• Decompress Counter-Strike: Online 2 texture files

UnCSO2 supports every Counter-Strike: Online 2 region's game data. Those regions are: South Korea, China, Taiwan and Japan.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
